title: Daskam 32 — Matsya Avataram
description: Matsya protects the Vedas, guides Satyavrata and the seven sages through the pralaya, and restores the Vedas to Brahma.

source.translation_status: No sourced English translation was available in the accepted canonical source; intentionally left blank.

stanzas.sanskrit:
पुरा हयग्रीवमहासुरेण
षष्ठान्तरान्तोद्यदकाण्डकल्पे ।
निद्रोन्मुखब्रह्ममुखाद्धृतेषु
वेदेष्वधित्सः किल मत्स्यरूपम् ॥ ३२-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: While Lord Brahma went to sleep, asura Hayagriva emerged from his face, stole the Vedas and hid  deep in the ocean. The power for creation for Brahma came from these vedas, so Bhagwan decided to incarnate as Matsya (fish) and save the world before the Pralaya.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
purā hayagrīvamahāsureṇa
ṣaṣṭhāntarāntodyadakāṇḍakalpe |
nidronmukhabrahmamukhāddhṛteṣu
vedeṣvadhitsaḥ kila matsyarūpam || 32-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सत्यव्रतस्य द्रमिलाधिभर्तु-
-र्नदीजले तर्पयतस्तदानीम् ।
कराञ्जलौ सञ्ज्वलिताकृतिस्त्व-
-मदृश्यथाः कश्चन बालमीनः ॥ ३२-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: King of Pandya kingdom, Sage Satyavrata was doing Tarpanam in the waters. In his joined palms, Bhagwan appeared as a lustrous form of a shining tiny fish.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
satyavratasya dramilādhibhartu-
-rnadījale tarpayatastadānīm |
karāñjalau sañjvalitākṛtistva-
-madṛśyathāḥ kaścana bālamīnaḥ || 32-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
क्षिप्तं जले त्वां चकितं विलोक्य
निन्येऽम्बुपात्रेण मुनिः स्वगेहम् ।
स्वल्पैरहोभिः कलशीं च कूपं
वापीं सरश्चानशिषे विभो त्वम् ॥ ३२-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Satyavrata took the fish in his kamandalam of water, and took it to his ashram. Next day, it grew big in size and as the fish kept on growing bigger, it was moved to well, then to a pond, then to a river and finally to ocean.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kṣiptaṁ jale tvāṁ cakitaṁ vilokya
ninye’mbupātreṇa muniḥ svageham |
svalpairahobhiḥ kalaśīṁ ca kūpaṁ
vāpīṁ saraścānaśiṣe vibho tvam || 32-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
योगप्रभावाद्भवदाज्ञयैव
नीतस्ततस्त्वं मुनिना पयोधिम् ।
पृष्टोऽमुना कल्पदिदृक्षुमेनं
सप्ताहमास्वेति वदन्नयासीः ॥ ३२-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Then sage Satyavrata took the fish  to the ocean by means of his yogic powers. On expressing a desire to see the Pralaya, Bhagwan in the form of the fish asked him to wait for seven days. Then Bhagwan disappeared.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yogaprabhāvādbhavadājñayaiva
nītastatastvaṁ muninā payodhim |
pṛṣṭo’munā kalpadidṛkṣumenaṁ
saptāhamāsveti vadannayāsīḥ || 32-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
प्राप्ते त्वदुक्तेऽहनि वारिधारा-
-परिप्लुते भूमितले मुनीन्द्रः ।
सप्तर्षिभिः सार्धमपारवारि-
-ण्युद्घूर्णमानः शरणं ययौ त्वाम् ॥ ३२-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: On the seventh day, rains came, water submerged the entire earth. Sathyavratha and the divine saptarishis took refuge in Bhagwan.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
prāpte tvadukte’hani vāridhārā-
-pariplute bhūmitale munīndraḥ |
saptarṣibhiḥ sārdhamapāravāri-
-ṇyudghūrṇamānaḥ śaraṇaṁ yayau tvām || 32-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
धरां त्वदादेशकरीमवाप्तां
नौरूपिणीमारुरुहुस्तदा ते ।
तत्कम्पकम्प्रेषु च तेषु भूय-
-स्त्वमम्बुधेराविरभूर्महीयान् ॥ ३२-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Earth in the form of boat approached them and carried them. As the boat was being tossed in turbulent ocean, Bhagwan again appeared in the form of fish.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
dharāṁ tvadādeśakarīmavāptāṁ
naurūpiṇīmāruruhustadā te |
tatkampakampreṣu ca teṣu bhūya-
-stvamambudherāvirabhūrmahīyān || 32-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
झषाकृतिं योजनलक्षदीर्घां
दधानमुच्चैस्तरतेजसं त्वाम् ।
निरीक्ष्य तुष्टा मुनयस्त्वदुक्त्या
त्वत्तुङ्गशृङ्गे तरणिं बबन्धुः ॥ ३२-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The sages were delighted to see Bhagwan of exceeding glory in the form of a fish about a lakh of yojanas in length. At Bhagwan’s command, they tied the boat to to its horns by the king of serpents, Vasuki.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
jhaṣākṛtiṁ yojanalakṣadīrghāṁ
dadhānamuccaistaratejasaṁ tvām |
nirīkṣya tuṣṭā munayastvaduktyā
tvattuṅgaśṛṅge taraṇiṁ babandhuḥ || 32-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
आकृष्टनौको मुनिमण्डलाय
प्रदर्शयन् विश्वजगद्विभागान् ।
संस्तूयमानो नृवरेण तेन
ज्ञानं परं चोपदिशन्नचारीः ॥ ३२-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: As the boat was being pulled and taken around various regions of the universe, King Satyavarata and divine sages sang Bhagwan's glory and pleased with it, Bhagwan imparted the knowledge of aatman.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ākṛṣṭanauko munimaṇḍalāya
pradarśayan viśvajagadvibhāgān |
saṁstūyamāno nṛvareṇa tena
jñānaṁ paraṁ copadiśannacārīḥ || 32-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
कल्पावधौ सप्तमुनीन् पुरोवत्
प्रस्थाप्य सत्यव्रतभूमिपं तम् ।
वैवस्वताख्यं मनुमादधानः
क्रोधाद्धयग्रीवमभिद्रुतोऽभूः ॥ ३२-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
At the end of the pralaya, Saptharishis were put back in their places and Sathyavrata was reborn as the Vaivasvatha Manu.
Now Lord went in search of the asura Hayagriva and attacked him with rage.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kalpāvadhau saptamunīn purovat
prasthāpya satyavratabhūmipaṁ tam |
vaivasvatākhyaṁ manumādadhānaḥ
krodhāddhayagrīvamabhidruto’bhūḥ || 32-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
स्वतुङ्गशृङ्गक्षतवक्षसं तं
निपात्य दैत्यं निगमान् गृहीत्वा ।
विरिञ्चये प्रीतहृदे ददानः
प्रभञ्जनागारपते प्रपायाः ॥ ३२-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Hayagriva was made powerless and his chest was tore apart by the horns of the fish. Bhagwan recovered the Vedas from Hayagriva and handed over them to Brahma to restart the creation.
O Guruvaayurappa! Protect me🙏🏻
stanzas.stanza_roman:
svatuṅgaśṛṅgakṣatavakṣasaṁ taṁ
nipātya daityaṁ nigamān gṛhītvā |
viriñcaye prītahṛde dadānaḥ
prabhañjanāgārapate prapāyāḥ || 32-10 ||
